# Pocket Notes

A mobile-first notes app. Its two screens are a draft editor and a saved-notes list.


## Conventions
Use the existing storage module for persistence. Preserve the DOM data-testid attributes because browser tests use them. Keep user text as text, not interpreted HTML. Preserve existing notes and the current appearance. No dependencies are needed.

## Verification
Use run_checks for actual browser acceptance checks. Inspect the returned failures, then rerun after editing. The protected checks are outside this repository. A passing result belongs only to the source revision it tested.

## Completion
A draft survives navigation and page refresh. Saving creates exactly one note, clears the draft, and preserves other notes. Distinct notes stay distinct. Explain the change and its verification in the final summary.

events.detail:
All 6 acceptance checks pass. The fix is complete.

## Summary

**Problem:** The draft storage module (`src/storage.js`) was unimplemented. `readDraft()` always returned an empty draft, and `writeDraft()`/`clearDraft()` were no-ops. This meant any unfinished draft was lost whenever the user switched between the Draft and My notes screens or refreshed the page.

**Fix:** Implemented draft persistence in `src/storage.js` using `localStorage` under the same `pocket-notes:${location.pathname}:` prefix used for notes:
- `readDraft()` reads the stored draft from `localStorage`, falling back to `{ title: '', body: '' }`.
- `writeDraft(draft)` persists the draft to `localStorage`.
- `clearDraft()` removes the draft from `localStorage` after saving.

`src/app.js` already called these functions on every input and on save, so once the storage backend was implemented, the draft now survives navigation and refresh, saving creates exactly one note and clears the draft, existing notes are preserved, and distinct notes remain distinct. Appearance (`src/styles.css`) and DOM `data-testid` attributes are untouched.

**Verification:** All 6 protected browser acceptance checks pass on the current revision:
- Draft survives switching screens ✅
- Draft survives page refresh ✅
- Save persists one complete note ✅
- Saving clears the draft ✅
- Existing notes are preserved ✅
- Distinct notes remain distinct ✅
